17. The rash and negligent driving is the decisive factor in a case of accident.
Rashness is something done oblivious of the consequences whereas negligence is something done without taking proper care and precaution, which ought to have been there while doing something.
As such, high speed in itself per se is not the CA Nos.114/2019 & 128/2019 Satyajeet Singh Vs. State & Anuradha Bhattacharya & Ors. Vs. State & Anr. Page 10 of21 deciding factor.
What is material is whether the vehicle was under control of the driver or not irrespective of the speed.
However, speed has an element of risk and that goes up with the rise of the speed inasmuch as control over the vehicle in such circumstances becomes a casualty.
The possibility of losing control of the vehicle which is being driven at a high speed becomes higher and higher with the increasing speed.
